steps.en: Start the engine with one container
Loads as a Redis module and opens a graph browser UI on port 3000
steps.zh: 以 Redis 模块加载，并在 3000 端口开图浏览器

steps.en: Connect with the Python client and pick a named graph
steps.zh: 用 Python 客户端连上并选一个命名图

steps.en: Write and read the graph in OpenCypher
steps.zh: 用 OpenCypher 写入并查询图

steps.en: Executes MATCH traversals as GraphBLAS sparse-matrix algebra at Redis latency
steps.zh: 把 MATCH 遍历跑成 GraphBLAS 稀疏矩阵代数，Redis 级延迟

value.en: One low-latency Redis-class server holding many tenant-isolated graphs you query with Cypher
value.zh: 一台 Redis 级低延迟服务器，装下多个按租户隔离、用 Cypher 查询的图
